queries.outcome: Found the four model records the issue names. vep-uc-20261014-source-gpn-star is not the preprint: it pins a Nature article PDF, doi 10.1038/s41586-026-11005-5, which is the published GPN-Star paper.

Retrieved, 26 pages, sha256 d7dfe801... Version of record, Nature 659, 141-150 (5 November 2026), open access CC BY. The stored source record's hash (97f61ec0...) is the earlier accelerated article preview, so the URL now serves different bytes. Re-download in the same session reproduced d7dfe801.
Three supplementary files (MOESM1-3). No Source Data files are offered.
Supplementary Information, 57 pages, sha256 3f7e8f71... Holds Supplementary Table 3 (ablation studies), the paper's only printed table of performance values, which the preprint does not have.
Eight model repositories, the training alignments, the benchmark datasets and a precomputed score set; none gated or private.
No results file: the repository holds the package, docs and demo notebooks only. Not pinned as a source for this batch.

decision: Pinned the Nature version of record and its Supplementary Information and extracted every printed value in them: Supplementary Table 3 (8 settings x 7 benchmarks), the 12 printed bar labels of Fig. 4b and the four rare variant association gene counts in the Results. The bioRxiv v1 preprint named in issue #226 is pinned for the version record only; no value is taken from it.
gaps: Figs. 2 and 3, Fig. 4a,c,d, Extended Data Figs. 1-10 and Supplementary Figs. 1-27 print no numerical values, so the paper's headline comparisons against CADD, GPN-MSA, Evo 2, Nucleotide Transformer, ESM-1b, Enformer, Borzoi, AlphaGenome, AlphaMissense, PrimateAI-3D, PromoterAI, SpeciesLM, GPN-Promoter, PhyloP and PhastCons could not be extracted.
No Source Data files are published with the article, so none of those figures can be recomputed from the source's own rows.

Supplementary Tables 5-8 (variant consequence distributions for the top 0.1% most constrained variants) print counts, proportions, odds ratios, p-values and q-values; they were recorded as a claim for the values the main text quotes, not as results. See notes.md.
The non-human benchmarks (mouse, chicken, fly, worm, Arabidopsis) and the S-LDSC heritability analyses print no values and were not extracted.
The published Nature Biotechnology version of GPN-MSA, the GPN paper, the PhyloGPN paper and the TraitGym paper are separate batches of issue #226 and were not searched here.
coverage_claim: Bounded source-resolution and extraction pass for one paper, cutoff 2026-11-16. Not a systematic search of the GPN family or of the benchmarks the paper uses.
